sections.description: Architecture Topics courses vary with each semester. Topics courses can feature current events relevant to the semester in which the course is offered, be taught by a visiting lecturer, or have another reason for being offered only once or twice. Detailed descriptions of topics courses, when offered, are included in “Section Details” on Path.
